force_password_prompt.description: If true, add the --password flag to force a password prompt

host.description: Host address of the postgres database

no_password.description: If true, add the --no-password flag to never prompt for password

pgclirc_path.description: Location of the pgclirc configuration file. Empty string disables the flag.

port.description: Port number at which the postgres instance is listening

username.description: User name to connect to the postgres database
